task.description:
Implement Stage F7 - Tenant Onboarding GUI per the design in src/design/onboarding_gui.md.

The design is Type E. Implement all screens and wiring from scratch - no codegen.

KEY NOTES FROM DESIGN REVIEW:
- Backend uses state values: pending / completed / failed (NOT fresh/in_progress as in requirements text)
- Role guard: per-page Navigate redirect to /instances (not a route wrapper)
- Polling: manual setInterval in useEffect, NOT TanStack Query refetchInterval
- Idempotency-Key: generated fresh per submission in RegisterTenantPage (not in client.ts globally)
- HTTP 502 = Keycloak provisioning failure (specific banner message per error taxonomy section 9.2)

Files to create/modify:
  NEW: web/src/api/onboarding.ts
  NEW: web/src/pages/admin/onboarding/RegisterTenantPage.tsx
  NEW: web/src/pages/admin/onboarding/OnboardingProgressPage.tsx
  NEW: web/src/pages/admin/onboarding/OnboardingResultPage.tsx
  MODIFY: web/src/api/queryKeys.ts (add onboarding keys)
  MODIFY: web/src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx (add Register Tenant to NAV_ITEMS)
  MODIFY: web/src/router.tsx (add three new routes)

After implementing, run:
  cd web && npm run type-check
  cd web && npm run lint
  cd web && npm run build
All three must exit 0.

Commit to the feature branch:
  git branch --show-current  # must be feature/WF02-f7-onboard-ui-20260604
  git add -A
  git commit -m "feat(WF02-f7): implement tenant onboarding GUI ONB-UI-01..04"
  git push origin feature/WF02-f7-onboard-ui-20260604
acceptance_criteria: RegisterTenantPage renders with all fields; PLATFORM_ADMIN check redirects to /instances otherwise
Form client-side validation fires per design section 9.1
POST /api/v1/onboarding called on submit with Idempotency-Key; navigates to progress screen on 201
OnboardingProgressPage polls GET /api/v1/onboarding/:id; stops on completed/failed; clears interval on unmount
After 3 consecutive transient poll errors: error banner + Retry button
OnboardingResultPage shows slug + oidc_authority on completed; failure reason + Try Again on failed
Try Again navigates to RegisterTenantPage with prefill values
Page-reload restore: calls GET /api/v1/onboarding?hostname=<h> from URL search param
Register Tenant entry hidden from non-PLATFORM_ADMIN in AppShell

result.summary: Implemented RegisterTenantPage, OnboardingProgressPage, OnboardingResultPage + API module + router/nav wiring (ONB-UI-01..04). type-check PASS, lint PASS, build PASS.
